utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: My sister just got her concrete done in her backyard. I'm with my Italian grandfather today, and he's going to check it out and see what he thinks. So it starts here.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Okay, first I'm going to check this. Oh no, you didn't dig deep enough. Oh yeah, the right depth. You know why?

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Wait, Nonno, stand back a bit, the lighting is better over there. Look at the camera and say that again about the digging! My followers will love the 'expert' look.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: I am not talking to a camera, I am talking to the ground! You aren't hearing me. If the control joint isn't deep enough, the concrete decides its own path and cracks where it wants. Put the phone down and look at this seam.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah, cracks, I got it. But look at how smooth the finish is! That's the part that looks good in photos.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Stop. We are stopping right here. I don't care about the 'photo.' We stall the walk until you tell me what is underneath. If they didn't pack the dirt, this whole thing is a waste of money. Did they use the machine to hit the ground?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Because if they didn't cut deep enough, it's like if they did not cut it, and then it would crack someplace else. Yeah, yeah, it's good.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: It's a lot of cement. Look at him checking all them.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Yeah, yeah. Well, I gotta say they made a good job. So the cuts are good. Did they excavate the— Yep. Did they compact it?

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Lots of times? Yeah, because otherwise water gets in. And would lift it up.

utterances.speaker: grandson
utterances.text: Yep. Everything. They packed more and more.

utterances.speaker: grandfather
utterances.text: Did they put some stone on top of it? That's good. That's where it's supposed to be. They must be Italians. Who else would do a good job like this?
